== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for I've Got A Bad Feeling About This: the entry in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'' (November 1998), PDF page 76, cropped at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Image for [[I've Got A Bad Feeling About This (Decipher Errata 1998)]].
